question.text: Yamuna Impact Fund (Cat II): Committed Capital INR 200 crore. Set-up costs = 2.0% of commitments, amortised STRAIGHT-LINE over 5 years (full fund tenure). Yearly fund expenses INR 50 lakh. What is the annual charge to the P&L towards set-up cost AMORTISATION?

explanation.text: The Logic: Set-up costs = 2.0% x INR 200 crore = INR 4.00 crore. Amortised over 5 years = INR 0.80 crore per year. (The yearly fund expenses of INR 50 lakh are a SEPARATE recurring line, not part of the set-up amortisation.) The Trap: A is the total set-up cost (no amortisation); C is 1% x commitments; D is a random figure. Cross-Exam Context: Chapter 6 Example 6.3 amortises INR 1.25 crore over 5 years = INR 25 lakh/yr — same mechanic. XIX-C tests identical arithmetic.
